mechanics.claim: Only the spectral riders deal damage to enemies they pierce, Hecarim only dashes and fears enemies at the end of it.
mechanics.quote: Only the spectral riders deal damage to enemies they pierce, '''Hecarim''' only dashes and fears enemies at the end of it.

mechanics.claim: The ability can hit an enemy multiple times as riders pierce through, each rider being a separate damage instance implied by the arrow formation.
mechanics.quote: summons 5 spectral riders {{tt|in an arrow formation|see notes}} that charge alongside him in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies in their path

mechanics.claim: The slow bugs as an additive percent movement speed modifier instead of multiplicative, and ignores slow resist, but this is a defensive/utility mechanic irrelevant to the damage fight.
mechanics.quote: The slow improperly counts as an additive percent movement speed modifier rather than a multiplicative one.
